nodes.label: CLI
nodes.title: The `ww` command
nodes.subtitle: Starts and controls a Wetware node.
nodes.what: The CLI parses `ww run`, `ww shell`, `ww perform`, namespace, and daemon commands. `ww run` selects configured root layers, starts host services, and applies process and operator policy to deployment outcomes.
nodes.built: The binary lives at `src/cli/main.rs`. It combines `clap` command parsing with image loaders and the host runtime. Deployment owns generation transitions; the CLI retains terminal behavior and process exit policy.

nodes.label: IMAGE
nodes.title: Image loaders
nodes.subtitle: Resolve code and files into an image root.
nodes.what: Image loaders resolve local directories, embedded images, and IPFS paths. The selected image provides pid0, cell binaries, and configuration in an FHS-shaped tree.
nodes.built: `HostPathLoader`, `EmbeddedLoader`, `IpfsLoader`, and `ChainLoader` provide the source selection. The loader boundary keeps cell execution independent from where the bytes came from.

nodes.label: HOST
nodes.title: Host supervisor
nodes.subtitle: Owns the node service threads.
nodes.what: The `Host` supervisor starts and stops the swarm, WAGI service, compiler, admin service, and executor pool. Long-running services own dedicated threads; deployment coordination runs in the main host runtime.
nodes.built: `src/services.rs` defines `Service` and `Host`. `src/host.rs` owns libp2p behavior and swarm events. The executor pool uses local runtimes because Wasmtime stores are not `Send`.

nodes.label: DEPLOY
nodes.title: Deployment lifecycle
nodes.subtitle: Turns optional Stem state into one rooted kernel generation.
nodes.what: Deployment allocates host-local epochs, revokes old authority, prepares and pins an effective root, waits for old pid0 teardown, activates `CidTree`, and launches one new kernel generation.
nodes.built: `src/stem` defines the backend-neutral Source contract and Atom finalized-depth adapter. `src/deployment` owns retry, supersession, pin ownership, activation, and generation coordination. `crates/authority` enforces the resulting local epoch.

nodes.label: PID0
nodes.title: Trusted pid0 kernel
nodes.subtitle: The only local process that can graft node authority.
nodes.what: Pid0 receives the process-local root `Membrane`. The default Rust implementation grafts `host` and `runtime`, installs the `/status` composition, and commits readiness for its captured epoch.
nodes.built: `src/kernel.rs` resolves pid0 bytes and records their CID. `std/kernel/src/lib.rs` runs the default Rust composition through `system::run`. The private `kernel-ready` import is installed only for pid0.

nodes.label: STATUS
nodes.title: Default `/status` composition
nodes.subtitle: The Rust pid0 installs the shipped status cell.
nodes.what: The default Rust pid0 reads `bin/status.wasm`, loads it through `Runtime`, and registers the result at `/status`. The status cell receives only the explicit `host` grant. Other guest components need an application-specific composition path.
nodes.built: `install_status_route` reads the component from the image root, calls `Runtime.load`, and asks the host HTTP listener to register the executor. The pid0 uses the process-local root membrane directly and does not publish it through the composition.

nodes.label: RUNTIME
nodes.title: Runtime capability
nodes.subtitle: Compiles arbitrary WASM bytes.
nodes.what: `Runtime` is the powerful loading capability. A holder can select WASM bytes and receive an `Executor` that is permanently bound to those bytes.
nodes.built: `RuntimeImpl` lives in `src/launcher.rs`. It compiles with Wasmtime and caches compiled executors. The capability boundary keeps the compiler and host services out of the executor API.

nodes.label: EXECUTOR
nodes.title: Image-bound executor
nodes.subtitle: Spawns a cell with explicit grants.
nodes.what: `Executor.spawn(args, env, grants)` creates a process for one pinned binary. A child receives the exact parent-selected named grants and fixed computation substrate.
nodes.built: `src/launcher.rs` bridges Cap’n Proto RPC requests to `cell::Builder`. Executors do not contain a `Runtime` or ambient host authority.

nodes.label: MEMBRANE
nodes.title: Capability membrane
nodes.subtitle: Attenuates a reference and preserves the restriction.
nodes.what: The membrane enforces an allowlist at the Cap’n Proto hook level. It also re-wraps returned, pipelined, and resolved capabilities so an allowed call cannot escape the policy.
nodes.built: `Policy` checks every call through the wrapped `ClientHook`. `crates/rpc` provides the host capability servers, initial grants, routing, streams, and HTTP listeners.

nodes.label: CELL
nodes.title: Isolated WASM cell
nodes.subtitle: A process with no ambient node authority.
nodes.what: A cell has local computation, spawn-selected arguments and environment, stdio, clocks, randomness, and a private writable `/tmp`. Application authority arrives only through explicit grants.
nodes.built: `crates/cell` contains Wasmtime process execution, image mounting, stream plumbing, filesystem interception, fuel scheduling, and virtual filesystems. `WW_CELL_MODE` selects vat, raw, HTTP, or pid0 stdio behavior.

nodes.label: RPC
nodes.title: Cap’n Proto RPC
nodes.subtitle: Carries typed capability calls.
nodes.what: RPC connects cells to host-provided capabilities through in-memory duplex streams. It also carries vat service calls over libp2p streams between peers.
nodes.built: `crates/rpc` implements grafts, initial authority records, named capabilities, stream dialing and listening, routing, WAGI, and connection budgets.

nodes.label: SWARM
nodes.title: libp2p swarm
nodes.subtitle: Provides peer identity, routing, and streams.
nodes.what: The swarm runs Wetware’s peer-to-peer network. It manages Kademlia routing, identity, streams, relays, reachability, peer discovery, and service transports.
nodes.built: `src/host.rs` builds the libp2p behavior. The runtime distinguishes WAN and LAN DHT requests and routes commands between capability implementations and the swarm loop.

nodes.label: HTTP
nodes.title: WAGI dispatcher
nodes.subtitle: Converts an HTTP request into a fresh cell invocation.
nodes.what: The WAGI service matches an HTTP route, sends the request to an executor-local task, and returns the guest CGI response. A request cannot hold an executor directly across the Axum thread boundary.
nodes.built: `src/dispatcher` defines the protocol adapter interface. `WagiService` owns the Axum server and uses channels to preserve the `!Send` Cap’n Proto executor boundary.
